##### Project general facts

Golf Greens at Damac Hills is an exclusive residential development by DAMAC Properties, situated within the prestigious golf community of Damac Hills. The project offers a collection of elegantly designed apartments that combine contemporary architecture with panoramic views of the Trump International Golf Club Dubai. Floor-to-ceiling windows, spacious layouts, and a design philosophy focused on connecting indoor spaces with the surrounding greenery create a refined living environment that blends modern sophistication with the tranquility of nature.

The development features a comprehensive range of lifestyle amenities designed to support both relaxation and active living. Residents have access to a swimming pool, state-of-the-art fitness center, wellness facilities, retail outlets, dining venues, and leisure spaces integrated throughout the community. In addition, the wider Damac Hills master development offers access to landscaped parks, sports facilities, golf amenities, and family-oriented attractions, creating a well-balanced lifestyle destination suitable for individuals and families alike.

The interiors are finished to a high standard with meticulous attention to detail, featuring spacious layouts, quality fittings, premium fixtures, and integrated smart technology throughout the living areas, kitchens, and bathrooms. Kitchens come fully equipped with appliances, ensuring convenience and functionality for everyday living. The residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalize their interiors while enjoying a contemporary luxury standard focused on comfort, quality, and elegant design.

##### Location description and benefits 

Damac Hills is an exquisite community nestled within the heart of Dubai. Known for its luxurious living and world-class amenities, this prestigious development spans over 42 million square feet and offers a wide range of residential options, including villas, townhouses, and apartments. Designed to provide residents with a lavish and convenient lifestyle, Damac Hills combines stunning architecture, meticulously landscaped surroundings, and an array of leisure facilities.

The community of Damac Hills is meticulously planned to offer residents a wealth of amenities and services. The Trump International Golf Club, designed by golf legend Tiger Woods, serves as the centerpiece of the community and provides residents with an unrivaled golfing experience. In addition to golf, Damac Hills features lush green parks, jogging tracks, and cycling paths, encouraging an active and healthy lifestyle.

Damac Hills is not just a residential community; it also caters to the needs of its residents through its vast range of retail outlets, gourmet restaurants, and state-of-the-art fitness centers. The community's vibrant atmosphere is further complemented by its entertainment offerings, including the luxurious Damac Hills Drive-In Cinema and the popular Carrefour supermarket, ensuring that residents have access to all their daily needs and entertainment options within close proximity.
